title: 2nd sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/2/2024).

From the Speaker's desk: the President's submission under Article 129(d) of the Constitution seeking Parliament's consent for three persons appointed to the Cabinet on 29 January 2024 under Article 129(a).

From the Speaker's desk: choosing a Member of Parliament to sit on the Judicial Service Commission, under Article 158(b) of the Constitution and section 3(5) of the Judicial Service Commission Act (Law No. 10/2008).
From the Speaker's desk: electing members to Parliament's standing committees under Rule 130(a) of the Majlis Standing Orders.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to start the confirmation of three Cabinet ministers, pick an MP for the Judicial Service Commission, and elect members to standing committees.
